name: Lohri 2027
notes: CONFLICT RESOLVED: Hindu Blog/Bhakti Bharat/days.to give Wed 13 Jan (habitual fixed date); Drik gives Thu 14 Jan. Rule: Lohri is the eve of Makar Sankranti; the Sankranti moment is 9:14 PM on 14 Jan (after sunset), so Sankranti is observed 15 Jan and Lohri on the night of 14 Jan. Some Punjabi families may still light the fire on 13 Jan.

name: Makar Sankranti / Uttarayan 2027
notes: Sources disagree on the single day: DoPT RH list and CalendarLabs give Thu 14 Jan; Drik Panchang gives Fri 15 Jan (Sankranti moment 9:14 PM on 14 Jan, so Punya Kaal on 15 Jan). Treat 14-15 Jan as the window; rituals mostly on 15 Jan. DoPT RH is 14 Jan. Karnataka (2026 list) gives Makara Sankranti a general holiday; Gujarat celebrates Uttarayan kite festival 14-15 Jan. State-holiday info: Tamil Nadu (G.O. 613, 6 Oct 2026) and Kerala (NI Act G.O. 2026) 2027 lists are published; Maharashtra, Karnataka, Delhi and West Bengal 2027 lists were not yet published on 8 Nov 2026, so their state_holidays are inferred from the 2026 lists. Re-check once the GRs come out (MH usually early Dec).
why: Agriculture, food, kites, ethnic wear, electronics (pan-India)
